beliefs.label: Belong Show
beliefs.statement: I belong when I show up, even if I do not have much to say.

receipts.quote: I got to the court before Rowan and put the pinnies on the bench. When the others arrived, there was a place for everyone.
I stood with the shop crew during the holiday photo even though I wanted to skip it. I was glad later that I was in the back row.

beliefs.label: Let Friend
beliefs.statement: I can let a friend help without turning it into a debt.

receipts.quote: My bike chain snapped in sleet, and Rowan drove across town with his hatchback. I let him load the bike without arguing about gas money.
I told my sister the rent was tight this month, and she sent groceries. I said thank you instead of promising three favors back.

beliefs.label: Own Pace
beliefs.statement: My own pace is still a real pace.

receipts.quote: A fast mechanic finished six tune-ups before lunch while I worked through two bent wheels. I kept measuring the spokes until each rim ran true.
Rowan learned the new play before I did. I practiced the footwork slowly in the empty gym and got it by Thursday.

beliefs.label: Need Question
beliefs.statement: I need the question to be simple before I answer it.

receipts.quote: Rowan asked whether I wanted company at the hospital visit, and I could answer yes. When he asked three things at once, I just stared at the vending machine.
My manager asked if I could take Saturday, call a supplier, and train a new hire. I asked her to pick the first thing.

beliefs.label: Trust People
beliefs.statement: I trust people who do what they said they would do.

receipts.quote: Rowan said he would meet me at 7 for a pickup game, and he was already unlocking the gym then. I stopped checking my phone after that.
A supplier promised new brake pads on Tuesday and brought them Tuesday morning. I moved their invoice to the top of the stack.

beliefs.label: Room Gets
beliefs.statement: When a room gets intense, I go quiet before I leave.

receipts.quote: At dinner my brother pushed about my move, and everyone watched me. I stopped talking and folded my napkin until Rowan asked to get air.
The shop owner raised his voice about a missing receipt. I put my tools down and walked to the back sink before I said anything.

beliefs.label: Sharing Ordinary
beliefs.statement: Sharing ordinary time feels more honest than making a big plan.

receipts.quote: Rowan came over with dumplings and we watched a bad action movie without picking one in advance. That was enough for me.
I sat with my sister on her porch while her kid drew chalk roads. We did not need an occasion.

beliefs.label: Keep One
beliefs.statement: I keep one evening each week with no plans so I can reset.

receipts.quote: On Wednesday I turned down an extra shift and stayed in my apartment with soup. By morning I could hear myself think again.
Rowan invited me out Thursday, but I said I was keeping the night empty. I washed my jerseys and went to bed early.

shared_items.label: How I mean things
shared_items.statement: I use few words; a short answer is still a real answer.

shared_items.label: What feels like care
shared_items.statement: Showing up without making a fuss means a lot to me.

shared_items.label: How to bring something up with me
shared_items.statement: Ask one clear question and leave room for a pause.
